content_sections.heading: How to Apply WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the WCD Odisha Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WCD Odisha to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts is 13 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts is Online. Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts should be between 18 and 35 years of age. The age calculation date is 01-01-2023, as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for both Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts will receive a salary of Rs. 10,000/- per month. This is a contractual position with a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for WCD Odisha Anganwadi recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker and Helper recruitment. Candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q6. What is the official website for WCD Odisha recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for WCD Odisha recruitment and to apply for these posts is http://engagement-awc-Odisha.gov.in. All official updates and application links will be available there.

faq.question: Q7. What are the posts available in WCD Odisha recruitment?
faq.answer: The current WCD Odisha recruitment drive is for two posts: Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper. Both posts have 9 vacancies each, making a total of 18 positions.

faq.question: Q8. When was the WCD Odisha notification released?
faq.answer: The official notification for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker and Helper recruitment was released on 21 June 2021. The advertisement number is 2092/KA: 21.06.2021.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these posts?
faq.answer: The Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper positions under WCD Odisha are contractual jobs. Candidates will be engaged on a contract basis as per the terms and conditions outlined in the official notification.
